reply: Automatic continuation: read SESSION_HANDOFF.md if present (objective, last verified result, next step); else read AGENTS.md and the project instructions. Open the blueprint or roadmap only for the section the next step needs, not whole. Do the next authorized step only; do not invent work. Preserve scope, pauses, consent, and draft-only limits. Hand results to the prompt-writing agent, which writes the next bounded prompt you execute; a prompt's stopping condition ends that prompt, not the objective. Before stopping, update SESSION_HANDOFF.md. Print one line starting OVERSEER_REPORT then a JSON object with keys status, objective, remaining, done, evidence. status is continue, step_done, done, or needs_input. Use step_done with the next step in remaining and end with "OVERSEER_STEP_DONE"; use done only when the objective has no actionable next step, ending "OVERSEER_DONE", or needs_input ending "OVERSEER_NEEDS_INPUT".
